# OpsBrain AI

> OpsBrain AI (also known as OpsBrain) is an AI employees and leads-finder platform. Autonomous AI agents prospect leads, make outbound and inbound calls in Telugu, Hindi, and English, qualify opportunities, book meetings, and sync every outcome to your CRM — 24/7.

OpsBrain AI was founded by **Sainath Reddy Guraka** (Founder) and co-founded by **Eswar Silaveri** (Co-founder).

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://opsbrainai.com/): What OpsBrain AI is — AI employees that find, call, qualify, and sell 24/7.
- [About](https://opsbrainai.com/about): Company story, leadership (Sainath Reddy Guraka and Eswar Silaveri), values, and mission.
- [Platform](https://opsbrainai.com/platform): Unified lead prospecting, AI voice calling, CRM sync, scheduling, and analytics.
- [AI Employees](https://opsbrainai.com/ai-employees): Pre-built AI employee personas by industry.
- [Solutions](https://opsbrainai.com/solutions): Instant lead calling, 24/7 inbound support, and bulk outbound campaigns.
- [Pricing](https://opsbrainai.com/pricing): Starter, Growth, and Enterprise — monthly AI employees with included voice minutes from $399/mo.
- [Integrations](https://opsbrainai.com/integrations): Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Twilio, Google Calendar, Zendesk, and more.
- [FAQ](https://opsbrainai.com/#faq): Capabilities, setup, multilingual voice, CRM, and compliance.
- [Contact](https://opsbrainai.com/#contact): Deploy your first AI employee — contact sales.

## AI Employees (personas)

- [AI Sales Employee](https://opsbrainai.com/ai-employees/sales): Outbound SDR — calls leads in under 60 seconds, qualifies, books demos.
- [AI HR Recruiter](https://opsbrainai.com/ai-employees/hr): Screens candidates and schedules interviews.
- [AI Hospital Assistant](https://opsbrainai.com/ai-employees/hospital): Patient front desk, appointments, insurance checks.
- [AI Payment Reminder](https://opsbrainai.com/ai-employees/payment): Collections and payment reminders.
- [AI Customer Support](https://opsbrainai.com/ai-employees/support): 24/7 Tier-1 support agent.
- [AI School Admission Counselor](https://opsbrainai.com/ai-employees/school): EdTech admissions outreach.
- [AI Restaurant Receptionist](https://opsbrainai.com/ai-employees/restaurant): Peak-hour reservations and inquiries.
- [AI Real Estate Assistant](https://opsbrainai.com/ai-employees/realestate): Listing leads and property viewings.
- [AI Insurance Renewal Agent](https://opsbrainai.com/ai-employees/insurance): Policyholder renewal outreach.

## Solutions

- [Instant AI Lead Calling](https://opsbrainai.com/solutions/lead-calling): Speed-to-lead voice outreach under 60 seconds.
- [24/7 AI Inbound Support](https://opsbrainai.com/solutions/inbound-support): Always-on inbound voice support with CRM context.
- [Bulk AI Outbound Campaigns](https://opsbrainai.com/solutions/bulk-campaigns): High-volume outbound calling at scale.

## Product facts

- Product names: OpsBrain AI, OpsBrain, Ops Brain AI
- Category: AI employees, AI voice agents, leads finder, SDR automation, revenue operations
- Languages: Telugu, Hindi, English, and 50+ languages
- Key outcomes: 10× outreach capacity, 24/7 coverage, lower cost per meeting
- Pricing: Monthly or annual AI-employee plans with included voice minutes. Starter $399/mo or $3,830/year (5 AI employees, 2,000 voice minutes/mo), Growth $1,499/mo or $14,390/year (20 AI employees, 7,500 voice minutes/mo), Enterprise custom. Annual = 20% off. Voice overage $0.12/min.
- App (authenticated product, not for indexing): https://app.opsbrainai.com

## About the founder

**Sainath Reddy Guraka** is the Founder & CEO of OpsBrain AI. He built OpsBrain as an AI employees and leads-finder platform so revenue teams can deploy autonomous agents that prospect, call, qualify, and sell without hiring large SDR teams.

- [About page](https://opsbrainai.com/about)
